description: Q coefficient configurations for POE computation. Each configuration assigns weights to quality proxies. POE = (output_words * Q) / cost. Multiple configurations are reported as a range.

proxies.frustrated_discount: Weight applied to output from conversations classified as 'frustrated' (3+ corrections or explicit frustration). Lower = more discounting.
proxies.standard_weight: Weight applied to output from conversations with standard completion (no explicit positive or negative signal).
proxies.converged_weight: Weight applied to output from conversations with explicit positive feedback.
proxies.deliverable_linked_bonus: Multiplier for output from conversations with project attribution.
proxies.unlinked_discount: Weight applied to output from conversations with no project attribution.
proxies.branched_discount: Weight applied to output from conversations with regeneration/branching (ChatGPT only).
